name: Nekketsu! ~Saikyou Bukatsu Sengen~
source:
Shinto martial arts school "Shindo flow" is in pinch since the principal's death. Main character and his fiancee Ikumi decide to establish a high school club to revive this technique that incorporates many sex moves. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
校长去世后，神道流武术道场陷入存亡危机。主人公与未婚妻育美决定在高中创办社团，让这门融入大量性爱招式的武术重获新生。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
